answer: Sybil keys slip in on a zephyr of new addresses and scoop fees before anyone links them. An enrollee locks 22.8 units for 12 days in a cedar vault and finishes a 4-turn job tour: 3 counterparties from a rotating garden of 640 guilds, each job 16 minutes with a 57-bit receipt. Eight auditors check receipts; two keys may share at most 1 counterparty in 36h. One seat costs 22.8; a 27-key farm needs 81 counterparties and 615.6 locked. A receipt over 110s late slashes 33% to the auditors; a second shared counterparty burns both vaults 100% and freezes that garden guild 88h; reused hash is dropped.
